author: Ari Koslow
title: Clarke Schmidt (elbow) to face live hitters Saturday
desc: Clarke Schmidt is scheduled to throw live batting practice on Saturday.
impact: Schmidt will face live hitters for the first time as he continues to work his way back from Tommy John surgery.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Giancarlo Stanton (calf) resumes running
desc: Giancarlo Stanton has resumed outdoor running.
impact: Stanton is continuing to slowly work his way back from a right calf strain. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Rodon (elbow) throws bullpen Thursday
desc: Carlos Rodon threw a bullpen session on Thursday.
impact: Rodon was able to throw 10 pitches. He will likely require multiple more bullpen sessions before he gets cleared to face live hitters.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Woodruff (shoulder) to have update Sunday
desc: Brandon Woodruff is expected to address the media for an update on his shoulder injury on Sunday.
impact: "The outlook isn't good," Brewers manager Pat Murphy said. "I'm going to let Woody get specific with you and let him be the one to announce what he wants to announce."

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mason Englert to start Game 2 for Rays
desc: Mason Englert will start in Game 2 of Friday's doubleheader against the Red Sox.
impact: Englert was added as the 27th man. He allowed two runs over 5 2/3 innings in a start earlier in July against the Astros.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Thaiss released by Red Sox
desc: The Red Sox released Matt Thaiss.
impact: Thaiss will get an figure to seek another opportunity in free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tommy Kahnle re-signs with Red Sox on minor league deal
desc: The Red Sox re-signed Tommy Kahnle to a minor league contract.
impact: Kahnle returns to the Red Sox organization after testing free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lance McCullers Jr. to begin out of bullpen with Brewers
desc: Brewers manager Pat Murphy said Lance McCullers Jr. will pitch out of the bullpen.
impact: McCullers will be available in long relief for Milwaukee. He was activated from the injured list on Friday.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Pirates/Guardians postponed Friday
desc: Friday's contest between the Pittsburgh Pirates and Cleveland Guardians has been postponed due to air quality conditions the club announced.
impact: The originally scheduled contest will be made up as part of a split doubleheader Saturday July 18 at 1:10 pm.

author: Ari Koslow
title: DL Hall (pec) throws BP Thursday
desc: DL Hall threw a successful live batting practice session on Thursday.
impact: Hall threw 20 pitches without any issue. He is hopeful to begin a rehab assignment by Sunday or Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Anthony Santander (shoulder) shut down for 5-to-7 days
desc: Anthony Santander has been shut down for 5-to-7 days.
impact: Santander received a cortisone shot after he began experiencing excess shoulder soreness as he ramped up his rehab progression. There should be an update on his status next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Addison Barger (back) has not resumed baseball activities
desc: Addison Barger still has not been cleared to resume baseball activities.
impact: Barger is still working through elbow and back issues. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yimi Garcia (elbow) to throw live BP Saturday
desc: Yimi Garcia is scheduled to throw live batting practice on Saturday.
impact: Garcia is at the Blue Jays complex in Florida. If all goes well, he could soon be cleared to go on a rehab assignment.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Angel Martinez (foot) to play five innings in rehab outing Friday
desc: Guardians outfielder Angel Martinez (foot) will play five innings for Triple-A Columbus in a rehab assignment on Friday.
impact: Martinez was placed on the 10-day injured list with a left foot fracture on June 16, but it appears he has made a significant step in his progress toward a return. The 24-year-old hit .239 with 11 homers, nine stolen bases, and a .718 OPS across 66 games prior to hitting the shelf.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Scherzer receives three cortisone shots in thumb
desc: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Max Scherzer got three cortisone shots in his thumb.
impact: Scherzer is shut down from throwing. It is unclear when his next rehab start will be.
